name: telegram-plus
description: Telegram channel for Claude Code (enhanced fork of telegram@claude-plugins-official 0.0.7): draft streaming, inline/reply keyboards, button and reaction events, rich Markdown messages, polls, locations, albums, pin/delete, effects, custom commands, voice-note auto-transcription, instant commands (/status and an instant.json table of local scripts), images too large or tall for a photo sent as documents, private document intake (/scan private → paperless, never shown to the session). Same access control and state dir.
